asset_ownership_interpretation: Earner customers transferred all rights and title in their cryptocurrency to Block Earner, which could use and lend the assets at its sole discretion while owing a contractual return.
affected_product: USD Earner, Gold Earner and Crypto Earner
notes: Platform-owned classification follows the product terms described in ASIC's amended concise statement. It applies only to Earner and not to the separate Access product.

asset_ownership_interpretation: Flint operated custodial yield balances and deployed funds through institutional and DeFi counterparties, but reviewed public sources do not establish one complete legal ownership or insolvency-priority treatment for every product and asset.

notes: The first-party withdrawal guide establishes platform-controlled lend and unlend mechanics but does not provide a complete legal asset-ownership framework.
